project.name: League of Pixels
project.summary: Fan-style 1v1 2D MOBA (Construct): pick a champion, destroy the first turret, then push minions into the enemy nexus; local split-screen and server-based online play. Page also promotes a Steam release, a remaster ('Kingdom of Pixels'), a Discord and a Patreon.
project.pricing: Free on itch.io; Patreon support link on page
